subject: Identifier
notes: kb/Work PB1425 (w1021a). SR1 (cite.py --check 8.4.3.1.3 -> OK 1)): every identifier slot of an identifier format admits any identifier format. Function, subscript and ref-mod nestings work (pb428 / pb1407), a data-address-identifier over a ref-modified identifier works (PB1407), the object-view (Format 5) and SELF / SUPER (Format 6) are identifiers of every sending slot (PB1425 w1019a / w1020c), and the last gap, Format 7's identifier-3, takes any identifier: a qualified, subscripted object reference, a chained property, a view, a function, SELF, SUPER. A property is itself an identifier inside another: a subscript (BAL OF AR(BAL OF D)), a reference modifier's position, a function argument and a relation operand all read it (probe w1021a/probe/PX.cob).
